SCENE 01 — A curious presenting gesture — final edit2.333s (0.000–2.333s)
Setting and framing: Medium-wide full-body view at Sol's face height, angled slightly down onto a simple woodland clearing. Sol occupies 36% of frame height at x=28%, with feet at y=74%; a small burning fallen bough is at x=74%, y=67%. Separate foreground earth, a middle-ground charred trunk and distant sage foliage into overlapping painted layers. Keep the lower fifth quiet.
Lighting: Soft overcast daylight from upper-left; cream earth, muted sage and teal distance, honey-brown wood. The existing wood fire adds only a faint localized warm tint.
First frame: Sol faces the bough in a shallow three-quarter orientation, both tiny feet planted and short arms lowered. Both original eyes are visible. A clear gap separates his body from the small faceless painted flame rooted on the wood.
Action: Sol lifts the short arm nearest the burning bough once along a small direct path into the supplied presenting pose while asking his opening question. Keep the arm length and attachment unchanged. Use a gentle connected body/tip wiggle as the arm moves, with feet supported, then settle. The other arm makes no separate gesture.
